question.text: The reaction of $P_2$ with $X$ leads selectively to $\mathrm{P}_4 \mathrm{O}_6$. The $\mathrm{X}$ is

solution.text: White phosphorus on reaction with limited supply of oxygen gives lower oxide $P_4 \mathrm{O}_6$. Therefore, air $\left(\mathrm{O}_2+\mathrm{N}_2\right)$ is a good source for controlled supply of oxygen and the best choice for controlled oxidation of white phosphorus into lower oxide $\mathrm{P}_4 \mathrm{O}_6$.
